# Welcome

This book is the central documentation for **DRMS**. It is organized into
separate chapter files and assembled into one book by `_quarto.yml`.
Replace the prompts in each chapter with project-specific information.

## How to use this documentation

Start with the project overview for context, then follow the getting-started
instructions to set up the project. The user guide describes common workflows;
the architecture, verification, and development chapters provide details for
maintainers and contributors.
